item.description:

Updates are being applied to IBM Blockchain Platform for IBM Cloud and the supporting infrastructure is being updated.

item.title: MAINTENANCE: Update Kubernetes Workers Nodes to Kube 1.17.11_1539
item.description:
What are we changing?

Reload all Kubernetes Workers in Db2onCloud clusters to 1.17_11_1539 level

https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/containers?topic=containers-changelog#11711_1539


Why are we making this change?

IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service Deprecated Kube 1.15 level, Clusters will need to migrated to 1.17_11 and Kube Wokers to be reloaded to 11711_1539 per https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/containers?topic=containers-changelog#11711_1539


How will it impact the environment?

System orchestration software updates will take place between 2020/09/23 to 2020/10/08 for Db2 on Cloud Standard and Enterprise plans.An updated Kubernetes version will be deployed to Db2 on Cloud Kubernetes nodes during this period. Db2 on Cloud instances will be restarted in order to complete the update. Db2 on Cloud Standard and Enterprise plans with High Availability option will not experience interruptions as long as Automatic Client Reroute (ACR) is properly configured. Please see our documentation for details on setting up ACR: https://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/en/SSEPGG_10.1.0/com.ibm.db2.luw.admin.ha.doc/doc/r0011978.html.Db2 on Cloud Standard and Enterprise plans without High Availability option will experience a 15 minutes interruption on one of the days within the update period.

The 15 minutes interruption will happen between 00:00 and 04:00 local time of the instance's IBM Cloud region.

Sydney (au-syd): 14:00 to 18:00 UTC
Tokyo (jp-tok): 15:00 to 19:00 UTC
Frankfurt (eu-de): 22:00 to 02:00 UTC
London (eu-gb): 23:00 to 03:00 UTC
Washington DC (us-east): 04:00 to 08:00 UTC
Dallas (us-south): 05:00 to 09:00 UTC

All other Db2 on Cloud plans are not included in this update and will not experience any interruption.

item.title: IBM Cloud Databases - Action Requested to prepare for July 18 IAAS maintenance
item.description:
What are we changing?
The IBM Cloud Infrastructure Team will be performing regularly scheduled system maintenance in all regions from 18 July 2020, 11:00 to 19 July 2020, 05:00 UTC (7/18/2020 6am - 7/19/2020 12am US CDT). As a result, some IBM Cloud Databases control plane operations may occur more slowly than usual. Existing instances will also not auto-scale during this window.

Why are we making this change?
The change is required for routine maintenance.

How will it impact the environment?
During the maintenance we do not expect any database instance, IBM Cloud Databases API, or console downtime. However, IBM Cloud Databases users will experience delays provisioning new instances or scaling RAM, Disk, or CPU as a result of the upstream IBM Cloud Infrastructure planned maintenance. Auto-scaling for existing instances will also be disabled during this period.

In order to mitigate any potential impact prior to this maintenance window, you should scale your databases prior to the window if you anticipate reaching your currently allocated disk allocation or expect higher than normal workloads during this maintenance period. You may use SysDig (via the Monitoring action within your deployment) to evaluate your current disk utilization in advance of the planned maintenance. Type: announcement
Regions: au-syd, eu-de, osl01, eu-gb, jp-tok, us-south, seo01, che01, us-east
Resources: databases
Type: announcement
Outage Start: Mon Jul 13 2020 16:28:07 GMT+0000
Update Time: Mon Jul 13 2020 17:50:02 GMT+0000
